items.name: NXC SMB enum_cve (batch)
items.description: Enumerate common CVEs via OS version

items.name: NXC SMB ioxidresolver (batch)
items.description: Enumerate network interfaces via OXID resolver

finding_template.title: MS17-010 (EternalBlue) — Unauthenticated SMB RCE
finding_template.remediation: Apply MS17-010; disable SMBv1; segment legacy hosts.

finding_template.title: NTLM Reflection to SMB
finding_template.remediation: Enforce SMB signing; apply relevant NTLM reflection patches.

finding_template.title: PrintNightmare — Print Spooler RCE/LPE
finding_template.remediation: Patch; disable Print Spooler on servers not printing; restrict Point-and-Print.

finding_template.title: NTLM MIC Removal (Drop-the-MIC)
finding_template.remediation: Apply CVE-2019-1040 patches; require MIC + signing.

finding_template.title: SMBGhost — SMBv3 Compression RCE
finding_template.remediation: Apply KB4551762; disable SMBv3 compression.

finding_template.title: Print Spooler Enabled (PrinterBug coercion vector)
finding_template.remediation: Disable the Print Spooler service on Domain Controllers and servers that do not print.

finding_template.title: WebClient/WebDAV Enabled (HTTP coercion vector)
finding_template.remediation: Disable the WebClient service where not required (enables HTTP-based NTLM relay).

finding_template.title: NTLM Authentication Coercion (coerce_plus)
finding_template.remediation: Enforce SMB/LDAP signing + channel binding; patch coercion RPCs.

items.name: NXC SMB timeroast (batch)
items.description: Timeroasting attack for computer account hashes

finding_template.title: Timeroast — NTP Hash Extraction of Computer Accounts
finding_template.remediation: Restrict unauthenticated NTP MS-SNTP; ensure strong machine passwords.

finding_template.title: PetitPotam — Unauthenticated NTLM Coercion (MS-EFSR)
finding_template.remediation: Patch; enable EPA/SMB signing; block coercion + restrict ADCS web enrollment (ESC8).

finding_template.title: DFSCoerce — NTLM Coercion (MS-DFSNM)
finding_template.remediation: Enforce SMB/LDAP signing + EPA; restrict ADCS web enrollment.

finding_template.title: ShadowCoerce — NTLM Coercion (MS-FSRVP)
finding_template.remediation: Patch; enforce signing + EPA.

finding_template.title: BadSuccessor (dMSA) Domain Privilege Escalation
finding_template.remediation: Restrict dMSA creation/attribute write rights; monitor msDS-DelegatedMSA changes.

items.name: NXC LDAP certipy-find
items.description: Certipy find via NXC - vulnerable templates

finding_template.title: ADCS Vulnerable Certificate Template (ESCx)
finding_template.remediation: Remediate the flagged ADCS ESC misconfiguration (enrollment rights, EKU, SAN, manager approval).

items.name: NXC LDAP daclread
items.description: Read DACL ACEs on target object

items.name: NXC LDAP dns-nonsecure
items.description: Detect DNS zones allowing nonsecure updates

finding_template.title: Non-secure AD-Integrated DNS Updates Allowed
finding_template.remediation: Set DNS zones to 'Secure only' dynamic updates.

items.name: NXC LDAP dump-computers
items.description: Dump all computer FQDNs and OS

finding_template.title: Machine Account Quota Allows User-Created Computers
finding_template.remediation: Set ms-DS-MachineAccountQuota to 0 and delegate computer join to a service account.

finding_template.title: Obsolete/Unsupported Operating Systems in Domain
finding_template.remediation: Decommission or isolate end-of-life systems.

finding_template.title: Sensitive Data in AD User Description Fields
finding_template.remediation: Remove credentials/secrets from AD description/info attributes.

finding_template.title: Cleartext Password in LDAP unixUserPassword
finding_template.remediation: Remove cleartext credentials from unixUserPassword attributes.

finding_template.title: Reversible/Cleartext Password in LDAP userPassword
finding_template.remediation: Remove cleartext passwords stored in userPassword; disable reversible encryption.

finding_template.title: LAPS Local Admin Password Readable
finding_template.remediation: Restrict LAPS password read rights to authorized administrators only.

finding_template.title: Pre-Windows 2000 Computer Accounts (predictable password)
finding_template.remediation: Reset or remove stale pre-created computer accounts.

items.name: NXC LDAP ldap-checker
items.description: Check LDAP signing and channel binding

finding_template.title: LDAP Signing / Channel Binding Not Enforced
finding_template.remediation: Enforce LDAP signing and LDAP channel binding on Domain Controllers.

finding_template.title: AS-REP Roastable Accounts (Kerberos pre-auth disabled)
finding_template.remediation: Enable 'Do not require Kerberos preauthentication' = false for all accounts; use strong passwords.

finding_template.title: Kerberoastable Service Accounts (SPNs)
finding_template.remediation: Use 25+ char passwords or gMSAs for service accounts; remove stale SPNs; AES-only.

finding_template.title: Kerberos Delegation Configured
finding_template.remediation: Audit delegation; mark privileged accounts 'sensitive and cannot be delegated'; avoid unconstrained delegation.

items.name: NXC LDAP PSO
items.description: List fine-grained password policies via flag

items.description: Full BloodHound collection (zip) for offline analysis.

items.name: NXC SMB Password Policy
items.description: Read domain password/lockout policy BEFORE spraying (avoid lockouts).

finding_template.title: Weak Domain Password Policy
finding_template.remediation: Set a lockout threshold and enforce >= 12-char complex passwords.

items.name: Kerbrute UserEnum
items.description: Enumerate valid domain users via Kerberos pre-auth (no lockout).

items.name: NXC SMB Password Spray
items.description: Spray ONE password across users. Check --pass-pol first; watch lockout.

finding_template.title: Weak/Guessable Password (Spray Hit)
finding_template.remediation: Enforce strong unique passwords; deploy MFA; monitor spray patterns.

items.name: GetNPUsers ASREPRoast
items.description: Unauthenticated AS-REP roasting of accounts without pre-auth.

finding_template.title: AS-REP Roastable Accounts (Kerberos pre-auth disabled)
finding_template.remediation: Require Kerberos pre-authentication for all accounts; strong passwords.

items.name: GetUserSPNs Kerberoast
items.description: Request TGS for SPN accounts and extract roastable hashes.

finding_template.title: Kerberoastable Service Accounts (SPNs)
finding_template.remediation: Use gMSAs or 25+ char passwords; remove stale SPNs; AES-only.

items.name: NXC SMB GPP Passwords
items.description: Search SYSVOL for Group Policy Preferences cpassword.

finding_template.title: Group Policy Preferences Cached Credentials (cpassword)
finding_template.remediation: Remove GPP passwords from SYSVOL; apply KB2962486.

finding_template.title: Group Policy Autologon Credentials in SYSVOL
finding_template.remediation: Remove autologon credentials from GPO/registry.

items.name: NXC SMB Dump SAM
items.description: Dump local SAM hashes (requires local admin).

finding_template.title: Local SAM Hashes Extracted (Administrative Access)
finding_template.remediation: Restrict local admin; enable LAPS; enforce Credential Guard.

finding_template.title: LSA Secrets Extracted (Administrative Access)
finding_template.remediation: Restrict local admin; enable Credential Guard; rotate service creds.

items.name: NXC SMB DCSync (NTDS)
items.description: Extract NTDS.dit domain hashes via DRSUAPI (DCSync).

finding_template.title: DCSync / NTDS Extraction — Full Domain Compromise
finding_template.remediation: Restrict DS-Replication-Get-Changes rights to DCs; investigate the account used.

finding_template.title: Domain Credential Material Dumped (secretsdump)
finding_template.remediation: Investigate replication rights and privileged access to the target.

finding_template.title: ADCS Vulnerable Certificate Template (ESCx)
finding_template.remediation: Remediate the flagged ESC misconfiguration (enrollment rights, EKU, SAN, approval).

items.name: Certipy Request Cert (ESC1)
items.description: Request a certificate as another principal (ESC1 abuse).

finding_template.remediation: Disable LLMNR, NBT-NS and mDNS via GPO/DHCP; enforce SMB signing.

finding_template.remediation: Reduce local-admin sprawl; enforce tiering, LAPS and Credential Guard.
